title: A Monster Has Chased My Town for 217 Years
description: If your truck breaks down, you never look back. Today it was the school.

scenes.narration: For 217 years, my whole town has been running from a monster. And today, our school broke down.
Every house here sits on a truck. We never stop. Not to sleep, not to eat. Not ever.
Because behind us, always, walks the Grey Giant.
Fifty meters tall. Eyes like headlights. It never runs. It never rests. It just follows.
There is only one rule. If your truck breaks down, you jump onto the next one, and you never look back.
But this morning, in the middle of a storm, the school bus coughed. And stopped.
Total panic. Kids climbing out of windows, teachers screaming, everybody running for the trucks.
And the rest of the town just kept driving. Nobody waits. Nobody ever waits.
I was the last one standing next to the school. Because my little sister was still inside.
The Giant came closer. Fifty meters. Twenty. Then it stopped. Right in front of me.
It bent down, slowly, and stared straight at the school.
And then it did something nobody had ever seen. It pushed the bus. Gently. Like it was helping.
It pushed us all the way back to the others.
For 217 years, we thought it was hunting us. It was just trying to keep up.
Turns out, it was our town's very first resident. Left behind on day one. Now it walks with us, and nobody runs anymore.
